skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the fundamental and advanced knowledge of contract law, principles of contract law, types of contracts, and the application of legal regulations in contract relationships.
Analyze the legal value of a contract, the rights and obligations of the parties in a contract relationship, and determine the applicable legal regulations.
Draft and formalize contracts, and determine the rights and obligations of the parties in a contract when disputes arise.
Conduct independent research, accumulate and enhance professional knowledge, and propose innovative solutions.
Analyze the conditions for the validity of a contract relationship, the consequences arising from a contract relationship, and propose solutions for contract disputes.
Effectively present research results and engage in group discussions.
Understand and adhere to legal regulations and organizational rules.
